literal_meaning: দাড়ি বা চুলে হাত বুলানো (stroking the beard or hair)
figurative_meaning_en: To stroke one's beard (indicating contemplation or satisfaction)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চুমরানো করে গভীরভাবে ভাবতে শুরু করল।
বুড়ো মানুষটি চুমরানো করে সন্তুষ্টির হাসি দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He stroked his beard as he pondered deeply.
The old man stroked his beard with a satisfied smile.
note: This idiom reflects a traditional gesture common in Bengali rural and semi-urban settings, often associated with wise or elderly figures.
